cues.text: You said yes. Here's exactly what happens next.
First, a short onboarding call. Your trades, your sweet-spot project size, your geography, and the work you want more of.
We agree on your coverage, and your cadence. A running feed, a regular digest, or both.
And we agree on your guaranteed number of qualified opportunities. It's written into your term.
Then I go to work. I monitor every platform that serves your jurisdictions.
I open the documents and read them. Scope, requirements, site meetings, bonding and insurance, and every addendum.
And I qualify each one against your shop, with a clear read on why it fits.
What reaches you is a short list. A plain-language summary you can scan in under a minute, and a direct link to the source.
You decide. Your team prices and submits. And as we go, I tune what I send you.
You keep the part that wins the job. I take the searching.
Questions before you sign? Reply to my email, or book a call at phildave.com.
cues.say: Questions before you sign? Reply to my email, or book a call, at phil dave dot com.
